text: Current full-sync deletion and multiget per-response add/delete calls await an item operation inside try/catch, log its path and continue. Separate unhandled DAV response errors still take the request-level error path; a caught item failure does not necessarily increase that response-error count. Preserve the item-versus-request distinction when changing this handler. Logging continuation does not prove that every item was synchronized or repaired. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: CalDAV sync catches item failures without turning them into request failures
